audit.whatIsWrong: Early-lane text attributed a silence to Force Pulse and placed it at level 1-2.
audit.why: Force Pulse (E) is a 400-range cone slow on 21/20/19/18/17s and cannot be levelled before 3. The channel-breaking tool is Null Sphere (Q), 650 range, 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, which also shields him.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-2 are lost to Null Sphere cancelling Breath of Light; Force Pulse only matters from 4-5 as a cone slow.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed between layers on rows 3, 6 and 7: phases[2].side='Skill', phases[5].side='Kassadin', phases[6].side='Kassadin' against win[2]/win[5]/win[6]='Aurelion Sol'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart reads Kassadin, Kassadin, Aurelion Sol, Kassadin, Skill, Aurelion Sol, Aurelion Sol — matching the content layer.
audit.corrected: Full layer brought to the packet chart as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two decisive interactions were absent everywhere: Astral Flight's terrain blocks Riftwalk, and Null Sphere interrupts your channels.
audit.why: Owner W is flagged 'terrain: creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes'; Riftwalk is flagged as a dash. Owner Q and W are both flagged interruptible channels, and Riot's Null Sphere text explicitly says it interrupts channels while shielding him.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, tradeBad, dontsFull[0].d, phases[3].why and dosFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing mentioned Void Stone, despite your damage being entirely magic.
audit.why: Kassadin's passive reduces magic damage taken. Every point of Breath of Light and Singularity damage is magic.
audit.corrected: Recorded in breakdown.carry and dontsFull[2].d — buy penetration rather than raw AP into him.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown-sequencing lines existed (packet defect confirmed: sequencingCues 0).
audit.why: Null Sphere 7-9s, Force Pulse 17-21s, Riftwalk down to 2s, your Astral Flight 22s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now gives the concrete bait-then-beam order.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are close to even-favoring-him since Force Pulse's silence and poke punishes your wide star orbit before it does real damage, though you can flip level 3 hard once your stars stack and your Q comet finally outranges his short trades. Levels 4-5 swing back toward him as his damage scales and your spike cools off, so treat this phase as a back-and-forth rather than a one-sided lane.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 favor him: Null Sphere interrupts your Breath of Light channel outright and leaves him shielded, so every beam you start inside 650 is wasted mana. Level 3 flips hard — Singularity on the wave plus a 750-range beam outranges his Q, and he has no answer that reaches you. Levels 4-5 swing back as Force Pulse adds a cone slow and Nether Blade resets his auto into a real trade.

edits.before: Kassadin's Nether Blade proc and Force Pulse silence punish your slow star setup early, but by level 3 your stacked stars and Q comet start outranging his short-range poke, flipping that single level in your favor before he catches back up at 4-5.
edits.after: Kassadin's Nether Blade auto reset and Null Sphere's channel interrupt punish your beam early, but level 3 flips it: Singularity on the wave plus your 750-range Breath of Light outranges his 650 Null Sphere, until Force Pulse arrives and he trades back.
